title: Existing rank-zero deformation factors and finite smooth tensor map
statement: For a finite commutative ring $A$ and a quasi-compact separated compactifiable morphism $f:X\to Y$, use the ordinary derived categories and exceptional adjoint [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. The actual Rees deformation and normal cone of its diagonal define the family and normalized comparison [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization]. FiniteSmoothGammaData consists of an isomorphism property for the actual normal projection, compactifiability of the Rees projection, a family comparison and its specified normalization at one. finiteSmoothNormalInvariant is the section invariant of the actual normal projection. finiteSmoothDeformationFactor is the specified zero-fibre specialization. With graph-normalized coordinates [def-pur-finite-smooth-comparison-coordinates], finiteSmoothNormalCoordinates is the section coordinate isomorphism for this normal projection. finiteSmoothRankZeroFactor transports the identity-adjunction trace through the normal projection and its zero section using the exceptional base-change mate [prop-asd-smooth-base-change, def-amb-vector-integration]. Finally, for an orientation $\alpha:\omega_f\simeq A_X$, finiteSmoothGammaMap is the right tensor unitor inverse, then tensor with $\alpha^{-1}$, then the canonical smooth tensor map [thm-asd-smooth-tensor]. These are existing constructions with all formulas unchanged; this node asserts no normalization theorem.
